name: eccentric single arm pull up
description: A slow lowering phase of a one-arm pull-up. It builds the strength needed for the full move.
instructions: Get into the top position of a pull-up, with one hand on the bar and the other assisting or at rest.
Let go of any help and shift your weight onto the working arm.
Lower yourself as slowly as you can until your arm is straight.
Keep your body tight and avoid swinging.
Step back up to the top and repeat, then switch arms.
